notes.title: OPEN THE GATE
notes.notes:
Hello reader
On 1.3.2019 ORDINEM will be released on Steam.
I wanted to inform you that the final version 1.0.0.0 was uploaded today on Steam.
In addition, I wanted to tell you that we have incorporated further successes that you can free play.

We are happy to give you our product and wish you a lot of fun.
